description: The single authoritative statement of the minimum acceptable version of every package this repository has deliberately remediated. Phase 37 (R36-03): these values used to live only inside scripts/verify-dependency-security-floor.mjs, so the control and its configuration were the same editable object — lowering a floor was a one-line edit to the very file meant to enforce it, and every gate stayed green while moderate advisories 1240100/1240101 sat back in the graph. The floor now lives here, in a data file with no executable behaviour, consumed by both scripts/verify-dependency-security-floor.mjs and scripts/verify-dependency-floor-policy.mjs.

floors.why: advisories 1240108 (high, <1.1.19), 1240104 (high, <1.1.20) and 1240100 (MODERATE, <1.1.21). Phase 33 set this to 1.1.21 rather than the high-severity floor of 1.1.19/1.1.20 precisely because 1240100 is only fixed at 1.1.21 — and the Phase 35 review demonstrated that every gate passes with 1240100 present.
advisories 1240109 (high, <2.1.5), 1240105 (high, <2.1.6) and 1240101 (MODERATE, >=2.0.0 <2.1.7). Same structure as the 1.x line: the moderate advisory sets the binding floor.

advisories 1240042 (high, >=6.7.0 <6.28.1), 1239934 (moderate) and 1240039 (low). This floor is already enforced by the critical/high triage gate, so it is a defence in depth against that gate being narrowed rather than a gap it closes today.
